content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for TTD Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanams S.V. Junior College, TTD, Tirupati (TTD).

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The advertised position is Guest Faculty across various subjects.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 9 vacancies available for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in directly at the designated interview venue.

faq.question: Q5. What is the walk-in interview date?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to take place on 08-10-2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for General and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC candidates is Nil.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for SC and ST candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for SC and ST candidates is Nil.

faq.question: Q8. What are the educational qualifications required for English Guest Faculty?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.A in English with Second Class and above.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: These are contractual government job positions under TTD, Tirupati.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF and further details?
faq.answer: You can find the direct download link for the official notification PDF in the Important Links section of this article.
